input: Investigate co-ownership mortgage schemes for first buyers

gold.taskTitle: Investigate Co-Ownership Mortgage Schemes for First Buyers
gold.taskDescription: Research available co-ownership mortgage schemes suited to first-time buyers to understand eligibility, costs, and next steps.

questions.title: Which country or region are you buying in?
questions.description: Schemes vary significantly by location, so knowing the country or region narrows the research to relevant options.

questions.title: Are you buying alone or with another person?
questions.description: Whether purchasing solo or with a partner, friend, or family member affects which co-ownership structures apply.

questions.title: What is your approximate total budget or property price range?
questions.description: Understanding the target price range helps assess which schemes are financially viable and relevant.

questions.title: Do you have a deposit saved, and how much?
questions.description: The deposit amount directly determines eligibility thresholds for many co-ownership and shared equity schemes.

questions.title: What is your combined or individual annual income?
questions.description: Income figures are used to calculate borrowing limits and qualify for income-capped government schemes.

questions.title: Is this for a new-build or an existing resale property?
questions.description: Many co-ownership schemes are restricted to new-build homes, so property type is a key eligibility filter.

questions.title: What is your target timeline for completing the purchase?
questions.description: Knowing the urgency helps prioritise whether this is early-stage research or an imminent purchase decision.
